Architecture

Pre-execution enforcement pipeline

Every command is scanned before execution. 25 deterministic regex rules. No ML. No probabilistic scoring.

Architecture

Deterministic enforcement
before execution.

TEOS sits between command generation and runtime. Every action passes through the enforcement engine before it reaches production.

STEP 01

Command Generated

AI agent, developer, or CI pipeline generates a command — shell, SQL, CI/CD YAML, or npm manifest.

STEP 02

Routed to Sentinel

Command intercepted via Telegram bot, API gateway, or CI hook. Zero config required.

STEP 03

Enforcement Engine Evaluates

25 deterministic rules evaluate against execution policy. No probabilistic scoring. Named rules, fixed thresholds.

STEP 04

Verdict Returned

Structured decision with rule ID, risk score 0–100, and human-readable explanation.

🛑 BLOCK\u26A0\uFE0F WARN\u2705 ALLOW
STEP 05

Execution Decision

Allowed or blocked. Enforcement is deterministic — same input always produces same verdict.

STEP 06

Audit Logged

Every decision persisted with timestamp, rule ID, and SHA-256 hash. Full audit trail for compliance.

Threat Coverage

Five threat categories.
Twenty-five named rules.

🛑

Shell Destruction

rm -rf, format, disk wipes, fork bombs. Wiper-pattern commands blocked before execution.

🛑

Secret Leakage

Hardcoded API keys, tokens, environment variable exposure in code and CI logs.

🛑

Injection & Evasion

SQL injection, command injection, path traversal, SSRF, and obfuscated eval/exec patterns.

🛑

Supply Chain Risk

Known malicious packages (event-stream, ua-parser-js), typosquats, and floating versions.

🛑

CI/CD Abuse

write-all permissions, curl|bash in pipelines, privileged containers, secrets dumping.

Security Layers

Defense in depth.
TEOS goes first.

TEOS is the first enforcement layer \u2014 not a replacement for sandboxing, monitoring, or static analysis. It stops dangerous commands before they reach production.

Order
Layer
Role
Tools
What it does
1st
TEOS Sentinel
Pre-execution enforcement
TEOS is the tool
Deterministic policy evaluation before anything runs. Blocks dangerous commands at the source.
2nd
Sandbox / MicroVM
Runtime isolation
Firecracker, E2B, gVisor
Contains execution in isolated environments. Limits blast radius if enforcement is bypassed.
3rd
Runtime Telemetry
Behavioral monitoring
Falco, Oligo, Tracee
Detects anomalous runtime behavior. Alerts post-execution. Complements pre-execution enforcement.
4th
Static Analysis
Repo scanning
Semgrep, Trivy, Snyk
Finds vulnerabilities in committed code. Post-commit, pre-deployment. Catches what TEOS never sees.
5th
AI Governance
Enterprise policy management
Wiz, HiddenLayer, Palo Alto
Broad AI security posture management. TEOS feeds enforcement decisions into their dashboards.

Why first matters: A command blocked before execution costs zero compute, generates no logs, and creates no blast radius. Post-execution monitoring catches what gets through \u2014 but the enforcement layer reduces the attack surface before it reaches the sandbox.
